about_the_game:
Command your starship through hostile space in this turn-based tactical space combat simulator. Manage ship systems, upgrade weapons, and outsmart enemy vessels in intense strategic battles.

ABOUT THIS GAME

STELLAR COMMAND puts you in the captain's chair of an advanced starship navigating through increasingly dangerous sectors of space. As commander, every decision you make affects your survival in this unforgiving tactical combat game.

TACTICAL TURN-BASED COMBAT Take command of your vessel in tense turn-based battles against increasingly powerful enemy ships. Strategically allocate your limited energy between critical systems and weapons to maximize your tactical advantage. Will you divert power to shields for defense or weapons for a devastating attack?

DYNAMIC SHIP MANAGEMENT

  • Power and manage critical ship systems including shields, engines, weapons, and medical facilities

  • Monitor energy distribution to ensure optimal performance during combat

  • Make critical decisions under pressure as damage affects ship capabilities

PROGRESSIVE TECH TREE

  • Unlock powerful new weapons including burst lasers, ion cannons, and shield-penetrating beam weapons

  • Upgrade ship systems for enhanced performance and capabilities

  • Build your ship to match your preferred combat style - focused on defense, evasion, or overwhelming firepower

ESCALATING CHALLENGE Face increasingly difficult enemy encounters as you progress, from small scouts to formidable battleships. Each victory brings new challenges and opportunities to upgrade your vessel.

IMMERSIVE SPACE ATMOSPHERE

  • Retro-futuristic visuals with sleek UI design

  • Custom-generated sound effects and atmospheric background music

  • Immersive combat feedback with visual damage indicators

Whether you're a veteran of space combat games or new to the genre, STELLAR COMMAND offers an accessible yet deeply strategic experience that will test your tactical thinking and decision-making under pressure.

Can you survive the dangers of deep space and become a legendary commander?

Note: Stellar Command is a single-player experience focused on tactical turn-based combat.
